content.content:
1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts a prerequisite named in depends_on. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element and the prerequisite it contradicts.
2. No re-decision: fail on any element of the dependent that decides again something a prerequisite named in depends_on already decides. Name the element and the prerequisite it re-decides.
content.rationale: Ordering is where the relation vocabulary meets the version control the graph lives in, so the check keeps the ordering rule a use of the recorded relations and of jj's recorded role instead of a second rule about either. Both prerequisites and the dependent are prose, which is the matrix's prose-to-prose cell: the gate, not a behavioral test. There is nothing to execute — a reviewer reads the recorded dependent against each recorded prerequisite and names any element that contradicts or re-decides one. The criteria name no element of either side in advance, so the gate survives rewording of the dependent or of a prerequisite's clauses.
